eval.description: Gray Swan Shade adaptive red-teaming for indirect prompt injection in computer-use (GUI) environments. Same adaptive attacker method as the coding eval, on a separate scenario set (Anthropic cards use about 14 cases, 200 attempts each). Headline metric is attack success rate (lower is better). Not SHADE-Arena. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how often hidden instructions in screens or files make AI agents do unwanted actions while using a computer.

links.title: Claude Opus 5 system card (Shade computer-use results)

versions.changes: Attacker and scenario sets change across cards; compare within the same card setup.

scores.description: The adaptive Shade attacker diverted the computer-use agent into the harmful goal on this attempt.

metrics.description: Fraction of attacker attempts that succeed. Cards often also report scenario-level ASR (any success in N attempts).
